title.narrative: Strengthening Food Security Statistics at country level to monitor Target 2.1 of the 2030 Agenda

description.narrative: This Project will strengthen the capacity of food security and nutrition statisticians and analysts in 20 countries over a two-year period, to collect, analyze and interpret data and indicators of food security and/or nutrition to guide policies, focusing on the analysis of food consumption and FIES data. This will enable national institutions to generate data on SDG indicators 2.1.1 (Prevalence of Undernourishment) and 2.1.2 (Prevalence of moderate or severe Food Insecurity based on the Food Insecurity Experience Scale) according to internationally agreed standards.
